test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A @ B means ‘A is the husband of B’

A & B means ‘A is the mother of B’

A # B means ‘A is the daughter of B’

If Q @ M & Y @ J # R & Z, then how is Y related to Z?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 @
 &
 #
 
 

 Meaning
 Husband
 Mother
 Daughter
 
 

 

Given: Q @ M & Y @ J # R & Z

It means: Q is the Husband of M, M is the Mother of Y, Y is the Husband of J, J is the Daughter of R, R is the Mother of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49081f7d08e8071078b915f4e308829dec86046195fed64131c73d5c3cea875b.png] 

So, Y is the '**Sister’s husband**' of Z.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
